patch_description: This version spends LP calls on a smaller, more promising set of repaired starts, then searches their neighborhoods using bottleneck-guided exchanges. Positive dual prices from `lp_detail` identify links worth changing; surrogate energy ranks proposed moves before they consume LP budget. A small elite of diverse networks and occasional randomized moves help avoid getting trapped in a single local optimum. All LP evaluations go through `tools`, and the search stops cleanly when the budget is exhausted.
